Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 05-Jan-2026 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DEC 2025 / JAN 2026  
  SUBJECT: CIV 1004/CIV_1004 ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIV 1004]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Explain how sustainable development helps in balancing economic growth with environmental              (5)  
  conservation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
1B)                Describe the social and economic consequences of mass migration from the Sundarbans?                   (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2A)                Sustainable agricultural practice is emphasized in the context of post-Green Revolution in India.      (5)  
  Explain with reasoning.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2B)                Explain the process of energy flow through an ecosystem. Discuss how the health of an ecosystem (5)  
  can be assessed.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3A)                Explain how industrial effluents and agricultural runoff impact water quality and aquatic life?        (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3B)                A site near an old industrial area has been found contaminated with heavy metals due to years of       (5)  
  waste disposal. Suggest five soil remediation methods to clean up the site.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4A)                Discuss any three Acts related to forests and wildlife.                                                (5)  
4B)                What are the initiatives taken by the Indian Institute of Bio-Social Research and Development for      (5)  
  eco-restoration?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)                Why is the Chennai flood called a "man-made natural disaster"?                                         (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)                Explain the factors that influence the scale of a disaster.                                            (5)

Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
